metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and skills maintained by Gep

plugins.name: destructive-guard
plugins.description: Deterministic PreToolUse approval gate, configured through env variables. By default asks before destructive commands on the local machine or cloud services; optional rule packs, an optional Jev classifier and a check skill to dry-run calls. Needs Python >= 3.14.

plugins.name: gated-dev-simple-workflow
plugins.description: Ticket-to-PR pipeline for ticket files or Jira issues: /ticket runs spec, plan, dev and review subagents in a worktree per ticket (git, Orca or iTerm2), with a plan-approval checkpoint and PR creation, then watches the PR: addresses review feedback (--address-review) and cleans up after the merge. Projects can add their own steps at fixed events (for example to sync an issue tracker). Includes a launcher that opens one session per ticket and notifies you when a launched session needs you. Treats approval-gate prompts as checkpoints; no gate required. With a Jira tracker it moves the issue To Do → In Progress → In Review → Done and posts progress comments, using the session's Jira tools. Needs Python >= 3.14.
